I had blood tests on 20/10/2025. On 06 or 07/11 I called for the results and was told by reception that “everything is normal.” I asked to collect a printout and was told to come in.
Today (10/11/2025) I went to collect them and was suddenly told I can’t see my own results because “some parameters are out of range” and I must speak to a doctor first. The first available appointment is 01/12/2025. So for six weeks after the tests, I’m still not allowed to know what’s wrong or how to manage it.
